summary: Capital One Funding, LLC, as depositor, filed an 8-K reporting that on October 8, 2026 the Capital One Multi-asset Execution Trust expects to issue Class A(2026-3) and Class A(2026-4) notes under an existing shelf (file 333-75276), with underlying collateral certificates from Capital One Master Trust and Capital One, National Association as sponsor. Underwriting and terms agreements for both classes, each dated October 1, 2026, are filed as exhibits. No price, size, coupon, premium, or board action is disclosed. This is a routine ABS takedown, not a special situation. Watch pricing and subscription levels at issuance.
